fields.statement: At dca2fdd, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/findings-concurrent.txtar runs four concurrent --leaf findings calls (verifier burst) and four concurrent --check alpha calls, and findings-concurrent-rounds.txtar (added for attempt 1's finding) runs four concurrent plain `rhiza run findings` calls on one run (the plan review round path). They assert the journalled IDs are unique within each scope: leaf f1..f4, check rounds 1..4 each with f1,f2, plain rounds 1..4 each with f1,f2 exactly once, and run status shows 4 rounds of 2. Ran: go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/findings-concurrent -count=5 passed. In a scratch worktree with internal/ reverted to the pre-fix 974f0ca, both scripts fail: duplicate leaf f1/f2, and all four plain calls report round 1. go test ./... passed. make check's fmt-check, vet and tests passed, except TestReadBudget, a timing test that fails only under machine load and is outside this diff; self-check reported only the stale render of the builder's actor record. Read the diff: lockJournal in internal/run/lock_unix.go wraps round/ID numbering in runRunFindings (internal/api/run_review.go).
